description: Source code for a test class 'SiloHealthMonitorTests' that contains unit tests for the 'SiloHealthMonitor' class. The tests cover silo health probing, including successful probes, failures, indirect probing, and handling of stale silos, using mocking frameworks like NSubstitute and testing frameworks like xUnit.

classes.name: SiloHealthMonitorTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the 'SiloHealthMonitor' component, focusing on silo health checking logic in a distributed Orleans cluster.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Asynchronously stops the monitor, completes pending timer calls to unblock any waiting timers, and performs cleanup.

methods.name: SiloHealthMonitor_SuccessfulProbe
methods.description: Test verifying successful direct probe of a silo and correct reporting of success.

methods.name: SiloHealthMonitor_FailedProbe_Timeout
methods.description: Test verifying probe timeout handling when the prober does not respond within the configured timeout.

methods.name: SiloHealthMonitor_FailedProbe_Exception
methods.description: Test verifying behavior when the probe method throws an exception.

methods.name: SiloHealthMonitor_Indirect_FailedProbe
methods.description: Test verifying the behavior when an indirect probe fails, including the selection of prober intermediary and health degradation scoring.

methods.name: SiloHealthMonitor_IndirectProbe_SkipsStaleSilo
methods.description: Test verifying that stale silos (inactive for a period) are skipped during indirect probing, and direct probing occurs instead.

methods.name: Silo
methods.description: Helper method to create a SiloAddress object from a string.

methods.name: Entry
methods.description: Helper method to create a membership entry for a silo with specified status and timestamp.
